Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Tribe
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Tribe extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player's tribe: the collection of Character cards and Building cards they have acquired during the game. Acts as the central hub for building effect triggers.
